online-updater.title: A. Use the Online Updater to Download and Install a Core

update-url.title: 1. Change the Core Updater URL in RetroArch
update-url.note: You can skip this step if you are using this project's build of RetroArch
update-url.p1: Change "Settings -> Core -> Updater Settings -> Buildbot Cores URL" to:
update-url.p2: You can also change core_updater_buildbot_cores_url in $HOME/.config/retroarch/retroarch.cfg directly.

download-and-install.title: 2. Download and Install Cores in RetroArch
download-and-install.p1: Navigate to "Main Menu -> Load Core -> Download a Core", select the desired core and confirm. RetroArch will download and install it automatically.
